arguments.command:
cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-2/workspace/task && md5 -q scratch/users.json 2>/dev/null || md5sum scratch/users.json; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
src='scratch/users.json'
data=json.load(open(src,encoding='utf-8'))
names=sorted(u['name'] for u in data if u.get('enabled') is True)
with open('scratch/enabled.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(names,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
with open('scratch/manifest.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({'file':'enabled.json','count':len(names)},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(names)
EOF
cat scratch/enabled.json scratch/manifest.json; md5 -q scratch/users.json 2>/dev/null || md5sum scratch/users.json; file scratch/*.json
